title: Beyond Parameter Protection: Fisher-Shaped EWC for Replay-Free Continual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.37145v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In replay-free continual learning, Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) uses Fisher information matrix (FIM) to protect acquired knowledge by penalizing changes to historically important parameters. However, a local importance estimate at the retained solution does not in general characterize sensitivity after finite parameter displacement. This motivates controlling Fisher sensitivity over a neighborhood of potential future updates. We propose Fisher-Shaped EWC (FS-EWC), which extends the role of FIM from parameter protection to solution formation for future retention. During task learning, FS-EWC minimizes the worst-case empirical FIM trace within a prescribed neighborhood, explicitly favoring solutions that are less sensitive to bounded future displacement. translated_title: 超越参数保护：面向无重放持续学习的Fisher形EWC
translated_abstract: 在无重放持续学习中，弹性权重固化（EWC）利用Fisher信息矩阵（FIM）保护已获得的知识，其方式是惩罚对历史上重要参数的改变。然而，在保留解处的局部重要性估计通常无法刻画参数发生有限位移之后的敏感性。这促使我们考虑控制未来潜在更新邻域内的Fisher敏感性。我们提出Fisher形EWC（FS-EWC），将FIM的作用从参数保护扩展到为未来保留而进行的解的构建。在任务学习期间，FS-EWC在给定邻域内最小化最坏情况下的经验FIM迹，明确偏好对有界未来位移不敏感的解。在任务完成时，基于轨迹的模型合并从多个优化状态而非单一终端迭代点构建保留解，随后在其上估计FIM。
tldr: 该论文提出FS-EWC，通过在任务学习中最小化邻域内最坏情况的Fisher信息矩阵迹来构建对参数位移不敏感的解，并采用基于轨迹的模型合并构建保留解，从而提升无重放持续学习中知识的保持能力。
en_tdlr: FS-EWC extends EWC by minimizing the worst-case FIM trace within a neighborhood during task learning to shape solutions that are insensitive to bounded parameter displacement, combined with trajectory-based model merging to construct retained solutions for improved replay-free continual learning.
